newsitem.title: UK: Two suspended Wickes managers to resign - FT.
newsitem.headline: Two suspended Wickes managers to resign - FT.

text.p: Two senior managers of troubled building supplies group Wickes Plc are to resign at the end of September, the Financial Times reported on Friday.
Les Rosenthal, group trading director, and Chris Miles, commercial director of Wickes' UK retailing arm, have been suspended since June 27, a day after chief executive Henry Sweetbaum resigned.
No-one at Wickes was immediately available for comment.
The Financial Times said the resignations were made known in an internal announcement.

An investigation into accounting procedures at the company was launched in June following the discovery of "deliberately misleading" accounting irregularities, and should be completed by the end of September.
Wickes shares have been suspended pending the outcome.
The Financial Times said Rosenthal and Miles have been assisting with the inquiry, which is being conducted by accountants Price Waterhouse and solicitors Linklater & Paine.
